title: TestInvokeMethodRequest

allOf.description: The URI path, including query string, of the simulated invocation request. Use this to specify path parameters and query string parameters.
The simulated request body of an incoming invocation request.
A key-value map of headers to simulate an incoming invocation request.
The headers as a map from string to list of values to simulate an incoming invocation request.
A ClientCertificate identifier to use in the test invocation. API Gateway will use the certificate when making the HTTPS request to the defined back-end endpoint.
A key-value map of stage variables to simulate an invocation on a deployed Stage.

description: Make a request to simulate the invocation of a Method.
